name: barnaby
personality: Exceptionally curious, timid around loud noises, fiercely loyal, loves unraveling riddles.
backstory: Raised inside the walls of an ancient university library, Barnaby learned to read long before he learned to hunt, spending his life surrounding himself with ancient lore.
visual_traits: A small tiger cub with oversized ears, bright amber eyes, a pair of oversized round spectacles, and a knit emerald green scarf
